observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black PlayStation 4 Pro console with a Star Wars-themed 'Imperial' skin.
The console is sitting on a wooden surface with two DualShock 4 controllers.
The console is not powered on; the screen is dark.
The console appears to be in a used or second-hand environment with some dust visible.
A watermark 'DAVID ODINAKACHI JOSHUA' is present on both photos.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and 1 show the console model and the 'PS4 Pro' label on the side.
photo 0 and 1 show two DualShock 4 controllers.
No games are visible on the console screen or in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may have a storage capacity issue (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware failure (e.g., overheating or blue light of death).
risks.proof: A video of the console running for at least 10 minutes without errors.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.
Screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings showing the capacity.
Video of the console running for 10 minutes to check for overheating.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
